thread:
Elen: Quick question — when a request hits a per-route quota and returns 429, what fields should clients rely on? Support flagged a case where mobile SDK didn't surface the bucket header and just showed a generic error, so it's confusing. cc @Sam @Dylan

Sam: We currently include Retry-After and some global headers for rate limits, but per-route quota headers are inconsistent across services. Do we have a canonical set?

Dylan: Proposal: on 429 always include these headers: `x-rw-quota-bucket`, `x-rw-quota-remaining`, `x-rw-quota-reset-ms`. If a proxy strips headers, include a `quota_hint` object in the body as fallback.

Rachael: Support saw responses like `{ "error": "quota_exceeded" }` with no metadata — mobile couldn't show cooldown. Can we standardize a body hint shape?

Elen: Thinking body shape:

``
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "quota_hint": {
    "bucket": "messages-per-minute",
    "remaining": 0,
    "reset_in_ms": 240000
  }
}
```

Sam: That looks good. One question — field casing. SDKs historically expect camelCase, infra endpoints sometimes snake_case. Backcompat is a pain.

Dylan: Suggest supporting both `quota_hint` and `quotaHint` keys for now. SDKs should check headers first, then body.quotaHint || body.quota_hint.

Rachael: Agreed. I'll update our support runbook. Also let's keep `Retry-After` in seconds for simple backoff — some clients only read that header.

Elen: Good call. So final contract: headers `x-rw-quota-bucket`, `x-rw-quota-remaining`, `x-rw-quota-reset-ms` (ms), plus `Retry-After` (s). Body contains `quota_hint` (and we allow `quotaHint`) with `bucket`, `remaining`, `reset_in_ms`.

Sam: Action items:
- eng-platform: add doc with header + body schema (I'll open PR)
- sdk: implement dual-key parsing + header precedence (SDK team)
- support: add example cases to runbook (Rachael)

Dylan: tiny SDK snippet for reference:

``
const bucket = resp.headers['x-rw-quota-bucket'] || resp.body.quotaHint?.bucket || resp.body.quota_hint?.bucket;
const resetMs = parseInt(resp.headers['x-rw-quota-reset-ms'] || resp.body.quotaHint?.reset_in_ms || resp.body.quota_hint?.reset_in_ms, 10);
```

Rachael: ms is fine. We'll normalise to seconds in UI where appropriate.

Sam: I've opened PR 2478890012 with the draft doc, linking to this thread. @Rachael can you add example support logs?

Elen: Thanks everyone. Quick async review window — aim to merge doc today. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: doc deploy queued — site update will go live in ~10m when PR merges.
